analysis:
Examined both test-document excerpts, CLI file metadata and both CLI patch hunks. docs/provider/cli-reference.md:1804–1810 now describes supervisor-mediated, drained pair restart after installation, bounded progress waiting and nonzero exit on deferral; line 2148 documents coordinated automatic-update slots. These documentation changes alone establish no weakened hash verification, authorization, encryption or rollback control. The supplied test.md:1838–2578 excerpts are unchanged according to the complete range map; their cache partition, memory accounting, media custody and retirement descriptions are not new regressions (notably T-041/A-001). The orientation excerpt for added test.md:1043–1085 describes staged bilateral updates, bounded draining, failed-download deferral, opt-out, isolated fallback and candidate start-check/rollback tests, but is truncated and does not prove execution.
Integration must examine UpdateCommand.swift/ClusterServiceUpdateRequest, ClusterPairUpdateCycle, supervisor and SelfUpdater interactions: authenticate peer/control requests, preserve release verification and build qualification (A-011/A-017, T-013/T-054), retain child/lease custody before restart, prevent unsafe unilateral installation while a pair runs, and preserve rollback authority and serving availability (T-043, A-018). Connection replacement must invalidate old serving grants and outstanding request state (T-053), without plaintext fallback (T-008) or duplicate completion/billing effects. None of those implementations is supplied in these units; their contracts remain unverified, not observed missing controls. No independently supported security finding arises from this documentation-only scope.
